log_level.description: Logging verbosity level (0 = none, 5 = debug). Higher values produce more verbose logs.

pid_file.description: Path to the file where the server process ID will be stored.

interface.description: IP address or hostname to bind to. Leave empty to bind to all interfaces.

port.description: TCP port to listen on for client connections.

ssl_enabled.description: Enable SSL/TLS encryption for client connections.

ssl_certificate_path.description: Path to the SSL certificate file (PEM format).

ssl_private_key_path.description: Path to the SSL private key file (PEM format).

ssl_ca_certificate_path.description: Path to the CA certificate file (PEM format) for client certificate verification.

max_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous client connections allowed.

max_document_size.description: Maximum size (in bytes) allowed for a single document. Use 0 for no limit.

client_timeout.description: Seconds of inactivity after which a client connection is closed.

auth_backend.description: Authentication backend to use. Options: 'none' (no auth), 'simple' (local users), 'ldap' (LDAP server).

auth_users.description: List of local users (only used when auth_backend = 'simple'). Each user has a username and SHA256-hashed password.

password_hash.description: SHA256 hash of the user's password (hex-encoded, no prefix).

ldap_uri.description: LDAP server URI (e.g., ldap://host:port or ldaps://host:port).

ldap_base_dn.description: Base distinguished name (DN) for LDAP user searches.

ldap_bind_dn.description: DN used to bind to the LDAP server for searching users.

ldap_bind_password.description: Password for the LDAP bind DN (leave empty if using SASL or no bind).

ldap_filter.description: LDAP search filter to find users; '{{username}}' is replaced with the login username.

ldap_user_attribute.description: LDAP attribute used as the unique user identifier (e.g., 'uid', 'mail').

storage_backend.description: Storage backend for collaborative documents. 'file' stores documents on disk; 'memory' keeps them in RAM (for testing only).

storage_path.description: Directory path where documents are stored (used only when storage_backend = 'file').

auto_save_interval.description: Seconds between automatic document saves. Use 0 to disable auto-save.

session_timeout.description: Maximum session duration in seconds. Users are logged out after this time.

history_enabled.description: Enable revision history tracking for collaborative editing (undo/redo support).

history_max_entries.description: Maximum number of history entries stored per document. Use 0 for unlimited entries.

service_hostname.description: Public hostname to advertise in service discovery (e.g., 'infinote.example.com'). Leave empty to use system hostname or IP.

websocket_enabled.description: Enable WebSocket transport for real-time collaborative editing.
